project_type: TanStack Start (React + Vite SSR) storefront + FastAPI backend with SQLite
build_system: Vite via npm scripts; frontend in project root, backend in /backend with uvicorn
test_framework: No test suite configured in package.json; verification is done via build: `npm run build`
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from the project root (c:\Users\JalipEmpire\Downloads\New folder (9)\veloura-apparel-main). Zero TypeScript/Vite errors = pass. Also confirm the dev server starts with `npm run dev` and navigates to http://localhost:8080.
environment_constraints: VITE_API_URL must be set to http://localhost:8000 for live backend calls. Without it, apiEnabled=false and all hooks return static fallback data immediately — this must be preserved. Backend must be running on port 8000 separately.
contribution_requirements: All API calls go through src/lib/api.ts only. Keep static exports in veloura-data.ts intact as fallbacks. Use @tanstack/react-query for all hooks. staleTime 30_000 for catalog, 60_000 for settings. refetchOnWindowFocus: true. Match existing code style.
key_patterns: api.ts exports `apiEnabled` (bool) and `api` object. live-catalog.tsx already polls /api/v1/products and /api/v1/deals every 8s by mutating the products array in-place. Components import static data from veloura-data.ts. The QueryClient is provided in __root.tsx via createRootRouteWithContext. Backend public endpoints live in backend/app/routers/public.py.
directory_structure: src/lib/ — shared data/logic; src/components/veloura/ — UI components; src/routes/ — TanStack Router file routes; backend/app/ — FastAPI app, models, routers. The QueryClient is instantiated once in the router context and injected into __root.tsx's RootComponent via Route.useRouteContext().
